chunks: Hammad ibn 'Isa narrated from Shu'ayb ibn Ya'qub from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who dies, how much of his wealth belongs to him. He عليه السلام said to him: "One-third of his wealth, and the same applies to the woman as well."

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ: A man at the point of death, the legal case being asked about
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ أَيْضاً: A woman as well, indicating the same ruling applies to her
key_terms.ثُلُثُ مَالِهِ: One-third of a person's wealth, the stated limit for bequest here

ai.seo_question: How much of a person's wealth may be bequeathed at death according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the amount a dying person may dispose of from their estate by bequest. The Imam عليه السلام states that the limit is one-third of the wealth, and that this ruling applies equally to a woman.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5422 - Hammad ibn ʿIsa narrated from Shuayb ibn Yaʿqub from Abu Baṣir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who dies - how much of his wealth he can bequeath.
Imam (as) said: "One-third of his wealth, and the same applies to a woman as well."
